thread:
devon: Heads-up — onboarding a new tenant (Org: Orchid) in eu-south-4. We need accelerator entitlements + networking increases before we can schedule instance provisioning. Primary asks below, opened AWS case already (Case# 987654321).
infra-bot: Automated onboarding checklist created for org=Orchid. Links: onboarding-docs /k8s-provisioning. Next step: quota requests.
maria: Do we have a backup region plan (cost/security)? eu-south-4 is fine but ask whether we should mirror to eu-west-2 for failover.
kai: What are the concrete quota numbers you want? also ENI / IPv4 pool / NATGW limits can be the real blocker.
devon: Proposed quotas for initial seed (3-month runway):
- p5 instances: 24 (dedicated reserved pool)
- p4d instances: 6
- g5 instances: 48
- Elastic GPUs not needed; these are full instance types.
Networking: ENI limit 600, vCPU limit bump to 4000, Elastic IPs 150, NAT Gateway throughput not a quota but request assistance for subnet/NAT sizing.
Estimated steady-state concurrency: 200 concurrent inference sessions (latency sensitive).

kai: Ok. That p5 number is sizable — we should stage with canaries. Can we start with 12 p5 + 24 g5 and a soft limit so we can burst if available?
devon: Yes, canary plan accepted. Start with 12 p5 / 24 g5 / 6 p4d. Request full bump to target numbers but mark 12/24/6 as initial active allocation.

maria: AWS billing/legal question: is Orchid on a dedicated billing org or consolidated? If consolidated we need to route the quota request through master account.
devon: Orchid is a new sub-account under our OrgMaster (account ID ends in 4321). I opened the support case from the master account and added the sub-account IDs in the request notes.

infra-bot: AWS Case created: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=987654321 (status: Submitted). Please add any attachment with network diagram.
devon: Pasting the text I used in the AWS case (copy to reuse):
```
Request: Increase EC2 Accelerator (p5, p4d, g5) instance quotas and VPC ENI/vCPU limits for account 111122223333 (sub-account Orchid) in region eu-south-4.
Desired quotas (target): p5:24, p4d:6, g5:48.
Networking: ENI quota 600, vCPU quota 4000, Elastic IPs 150.
Purpose: Dedicated inference pool for Redwood customer pilot (latency SLOs). We will stagger provisioning, start with 12 p5 / 24 g5 / 6 p4d active and scale to targets.
Time sensitivity: Need baseline for pilot provisioning in 10 business days.
Contact: devon@redwood.com (infra lead).
```
kai: Nice. Can you also include the expected monthly spend estimate in the case? AWS sometimes flags large quota jumps. Quick calc: 12 p5 + 24 g5 + 6 p4d ~ ~2500 GPU-hours/day -> rough $350k/mo. Add that figure.
devon: Added an annotated cost estimate to the case note: "~$300-400k/mo depending on spot/ondemand mix; expecting reserved/dedicated options after pilot."

maria: For network prep, I'll pre-allocate subnets and NATs. We should also request larger ENI quotas in adjacent AZs to avoid per-AZ bottlenecks.
sre-oncall: I'll set up cluster health dashboards and alerts for instance launch failures, allocation failures, and ENI exhaustion. Also adding automated rollback if launches fail >5% during onboarding.
devon: Thanks — tagging @cloud-ops to keep eyes on the AWS ticket. If AWS asks for architecture diagram I'll drop the VPC/subnet plan here. For immediate action: 1) confirm master account case note includes sub-account IDs, 2) infra to attach subnet/NAT diagram, 3) SRE to add launch failure alerts.

maria: Confirmed: master case includes sub-account and Org ID. Uploading diagram now. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Attachment uploaded: orchid-vpc-plan-2026-03-18.png

sre-oncall: Monitoring hooks created and test alert simulated. Will update thread once we see AWS case progress. :white_check_mark:
